problem: So when is he supposed to run the pump
action: The same morning, seen from out on the forecourt looking back towards the office. Two cars wait at the dispensers with nobody attending them. Through the office glass, small and deep in the frame, the dealer is visible still sitting at his desk over his papers. The forecourt in the foreground is wide, bright and unserved.
lighting: Bright morning sun on the forecourt in the foreground, the office interior darker behind glass so he reads as a small distant figure.
camera: Wide vertical shot from forecourt level. The waiting cars and empty island fill the lower two-thirds; the office and the small figure of the dealer sit in the upper third. Everything reasonably sharp. 35mm.
detail: The waiting cars are plain, with NO number plates, NO badges, NO logos. The office glass carries no signage, no lettering, no notices. No other people are visible anywhere.
feeling: The question the whole first act has been building to — if all of this is his morning, when does he actually run the pump?
motion: Almost nothing moves. A very slow push in towards the office. Nothing enters or leaves frame, no doors open, nobody walks, nobody speaks, no vehicles move.

voice_over.hi: सेफ़्टी डिक्लेरेशन, वॉटर टेस्टिंग, मिनिमम वेज, स्वच्छता, वर्क परमिट — रोज़। तो पंप कब चलाएँ?
